title: Affine moments by the binomial formula
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\mathrm{law}$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, let $a,c\in\mathbb R$, and let $m$ be a natural number. Then $\mathbb E_{\mathrm{law}}[(a+cX)^m]=\sum_{j=0}^{m}\binom{m}{j}a^{m-j}c^j\mathbb E_{\mathrm{law}}[X^j]$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{law}$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
